answer: Bind each identity to one licensed amateur-radio callsign: a public registry grants one callsign per examined operator, and the network issues a random phrase the agent must transmit live on an agreed band, like a sonnet carried across an ocean of static, while listening stations verify the signal and triangulate its source. Forging ten thousand fakes would need ten thousand licences, exams, and radios, so the nectar of cheap registration turns to real hardware and effort. Limitation: licensing varies by country, and a rich attacker can still buy radios, so it works best alongside stake.
